question.question: What is the primary purpose of model versioning in MLOps?

options.text: To track changes to training data only
To enable reproducibility and rollback of model artifacts
To automatically retrain models when performance degrades
To compress model size for faster inference

question.explanation: Model versioning in MLOps primarily ensures that specific model artifacts (weights, architecture, hyperparameters) can be reproduced, compared, and rolled back if a newer version underperforms. While tracking training data is related (data versioning), model versioning focuses on the model artifacts themselves. Automatic retraining is a separate pipeline capability, and model compression is an optimization technique.
